catalogue_note: The patterns are simplified, original programmable arrangements based on widely used genre conventions. They are not authoritative transcriptions and should be adapted in rhythms.json when a more specific regional or historical interpretation is required.

level_semantics.busyness: 0..4; layer 0 is the defining groove and each higher value adds the next stylistic percussion layer.
level_semantics.chord_activity: 0..4; every level is a complete genre-specific chord-trigger pattern. Level 0 contains only the first beat of each bar.
level_semantics.bass_activity: 0..4; each level is a complete rhythm-specific low-register chord-arpeggio pattern. Level 0 uses roots on the first count of each bar; higher levels use the rhythm's own accompaniment placements with progressively wider chord-degree motion.
